v6_contract_review.budget_formula: upload_deadline = min(overall_deadline - teardown_allowance, attempt_started + 240s); the same bounded deadline covers both archive and helper uploads and is passed to remote preflight.

Controller uses one overall deadline and reserves 90 seconds from benchmark work for retrieval/teardown. The phase values are caps and planning allocations; they do not establish that upload or the complete diagnostic fits.

regression_review.edge_interpretation: For a 300-second lease, startup is further clipped by overall work deadline minus the 90-second teardown reserve; the regression checks this shorter case too.
